طَغْيَا : see the next preceding paragraph. ＝
-A2- It is also a proper name for [The bovine antelope called] بَقَرَةُ الوَحْشِ; (K, TA;) from طَغَتِ البَقَرَةُ [expl. above: see 1, last sentence]: (TA:) [or, as it appears from a citation in the TA, partly mistranscribed so as to be unintelligible, طَغْيَا or ↓ طُغْيَا signifies, accord. to IAar, a بَقَرَة uttering a
cry or cries, or a loud cry or loud cries:] or ↓ طُغْيَا with damm accord. to As, or طَغْيَا with fet-h accord. to Th, signifies a youngling of the بَقَر الوَحْش. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
